paragraph: The Granville composite sits right at a neutral 50 out of 100 this morning, hard-capped at 60 due to an active divergence warning where the SPY is rising while the RSP-to-SPY breadth ratio falls by 0.73%. This internal hesitation unfolds against an elevated macro backdrop featuring a VIX at 24.74, a backwardated term structure, and widening high-yield credit spreads at 3.48% that reflect lingering systemic caution despite aggressive risk-on impulses from bellwether semis jumping 2.56% and high-beta outperforming low-volatility by 3.39%. Defensive rotation is simultaneously offering a bullish offset with the XLP-to-XLY ratio dropping 1.45%, while transports signal underlying economic drag by lagging the broader market by 1.70%. Weighing this internal market tug-of-war alongside front-loaded fear in the volatility skew, the session demands a cautious, neutral-to-defensive tactical posture until the breadth divergence resolves.
